run_training_speed_test: run the training speed test with an experiment config file and profile
run_profiler_trace: run the training loop with PyTorch profiler and export a Chrome trace file
run_scripted_autoencoder: run the training speed test with torch.jit.script applied to encoder and decoder
run_resume_training: run the training speed test resuming from the last iteration in log.txt
run_multi_device_test: run the training speed test targeting specific GPU devices by index
